title: Aftercare: How to Heal Your Tattoo Perfectly
seoTitle: Tattoo Aftercare Guide Dapto | Heal Your Ink Perfectly | Diamond Tip Tattoo
seoDescription: Expert tattoo aftercare from Diamond Tip Tattoo Dapto. Clean, moisturise, protect from sun — heal custom realism and fine line work the right way.
author: Steven Benn
excerpt: Taking care of your new tattoo is just as important as the tattooing process itself.
content:
Taking care of your new tattoo is just as important as the tattooing process itself. At Diamond Tip Tattoo in Dapto, we walk every client through aftercare before you leave the chair.

Keep the area clean with a mild, fragrance-free wash. Pat dry — never scrub. Apply a thin layer of the balm or cream we recommend (available in our Studio Shop for pickup). Avoid pools, ocean, saunas and long soaks until healed. Skip picking scabs or flakes; let them fall naturally.

Sun is the enemy of fresh ink. Cover up or use SPF once the tattoo is fully healed. If something looks wrong — excess swelling, pus, heat — call the studio on (02) 4261 4311.

Your free consultation is also a great time to talk healing for larger sleeves or cover-ups. Book online and we’ll map the plan with you.

title: Tattoo Placements: Finding the Perfect Spot
seoTitle: Best Tattoo Placement Ideas | Custom Ink Dapto & Illawarra | Diamond Tip
seoDescription: Where should your next tattoo go? Fine line on wrists, realism sleeves, chest pieces — placement advice from Diamond Tip Tattoo Dapto NSW.
author: Scotty
excerpt: Tattoo placement can make or break a design — match the canvas to the art.
content:
Tattoo placement can make or break a design. Fine line florals and script look stunning on wrists, collarbones, ribs and ankles. Large realism, portraits and black & grey sleeves need bigger canvases — upper arm, thigh, back or full sleeve.

At Diamond Tip Tattooing on Baan Baan Street, Dapto, we design for how your body moves. A piece that wraps the forearm differently to a flat chest panel. Cover-ups need enough solid area and strategic flow so the old work disappears into the new story.

Nervous about visibility for work? We plan discreet placements that still look intentional. Want something bold for Illawarra summers? We’ll talk sun exposure and healing too.

Book a free consultation — bring reference photos and we’ll sketch placement options before any deposit.

title: Getting Your First Tattoo in Dapto: A Calm, Honest Guide
seoTitle: First Tattoo Dapto NSW | What to Expect | Diamond Tip Tattoo
seoDescription: First tattoo in the Illawarra? What to expect at Diamond Tip Tattoo Dapto — private studio, free consult, pain tips, pricing and aftercare.
author: Steven Benn
excerpt: First tattoos should feel exciting — not rushed or intimidating.
content:
Your first tattoo should feel exciting, not intimidating. Diamond Tip is appointment-only: private, no walk-in crowds, time to get the design right.

Start with a free consultation. Tell us your idea, budget and any nerves. We’ll suggest size, style (fine line, realism, black & grey, traditional) and a realistic session plan. Small pieces can be under an hour; larger work may need multiple sessions.

Pain is personal. Outer arms and calves are usually easier; ribs and feet tend to sting more. We take breaks if you need them. Bring ID — you must be 18+.

Eat beforehand, hydrate, wear clothes that give easy access to the area. After the session you leave with clear aftercare and a healed-result focus — not a rushed stencil and goodbye.

Serving Dapto, Wollongong, Shellharbour and the Illawarra. Book online or call (02) 4261 4311.

seoDescription: Hyper-real portraits, animals and memorial pieces at Diamond Tip Tattoo Dapto. Award-winning realism for Wollongong and Illawarra clients.
author: Steven Benn
excerpt: Realism rewards patience — reference photos, solid black & grey, and healing.
content:
Realism tattoos — portraits, animals, memorials — reward patience. Great reference photos, strong contrast, and careful healing keep the piece readable for years.

Steven Benn and the Diamond Tip crew specialise in custom realism and black & grey with decades of combined experience and industry awards. We won’t force a tiny photoreal face into a space that can’t hold the detail; we’ll resize or reframe so it lasts.

Expect a consult, a design pass, and often more than one session for larger work. Bring the best high-resolution photos you have. For cover-ups, realism can swallow old ink if the canvas and flow are right.

See portfolio work on this site, Instagram @diamondtiptattoodapto and Facebook @diamondtiptattoo. Ready? Book a free consultation.

title: Fine Line Tattoos: Delicate Work That Still Lasts
seoTitle: Fine Line Tattoo Dapto | Delicate Script & Florals | Diamond Tip Tattoo
seoDescription: Fine line tattoos done properly in Dapto NSW — script, florals, ornamental. How we keep delicate ink crisp as it heals.
author: Scotty
excerpt: Fine line isn’t weak line — it’s precise work that needs the right hand and aftercare.
content:
Fine line isn’t “weak line.” It’s precise single-needle and thin-group work for script, botanicals, ornamental mandalas and minimal designs. Done poorly, it blows out or fades into mush. Done well, it stays crisp.

At Diamond Tip we match line weight to your skin and placement. Oily skin, high-friction areas and constant sun all affect longevity — we’ll say so upfront. Aftercare matters even more: light moisture, no picking, UV protection once healed.

Perfect for first tattoos or adding soft detail next to heavier blackwork. Pair fine line with black & grey realism for mixed styles that still feel cohesive.

Browse our fine line portfolio and book a consult to test sizes on skin before we commit ink.

title: Cover-Up Tattoos: Turning Old Ink Into New Art
seoTitle: Tattoo Cover Up Dapto & Wollongong | Diamond Tip Tattoo
seoDescription: Cover-up specialists in Dapto NSW. Transform faded or unwanted tattoos with custom design from Diamond Tip Tattoo.
author: Steven Benn
excerpt: A good cover-up is design first — not just blacking over regret.
content:
A good cover-up is design first, not just blacking over the past. We assess colour, density, scarring and placement, then build a new composition that uses shadow, flow and subject matter to hide the old piece.

Sometimes laser lightening first is the honest path; sometimes a single strong session works. We’ll tell you which. Cover-ups often need more space and darker values than clients expect — that’s physics, not upselling.

Diamond Tip has decades of cover-up experience across styles: traditional, neo-trad, blackwork and realism. Private studio, appointment only, clear pricing after consult.

Send clear photos of the existing tattoo with your online booking so we can prepare ideas before you arrive.
